label: Pagination pushdown
type: pushing LIMIT and OFFSET into the index scan. Member of index:index-pushdown. DISTINGUISH FROM early pagination (index:early-order-and-pagination), which is what the Query service does when pagination CANNOT be pushed down - the two are alternatives, not synonyms, and the documentation places them on different pages.
recurrence_note: Six files discounted to 3 independent sources: `shared`, so the discount stands. Three sources still clears the bar comfortably.
note: PROMOTED. The contrast with early pagination is the load-bearing distinction and it is stated across two pages rather than on either one, which is worth recording: early-filters-and-pagination.md explains what the Query service does when the pushdown is unavailable, and index_pushdowns.md explains the pushdown, and neither says 'this is the fallback for that' in so many words. The relationship is inferable from both pages together and stated on neither.
